rules.description: Onboard examples model embedded targets: they must not depend on QtNetwork or QtSql, which is what actually separates them from their offboard sibling.
A game may depend on games.common for LAN transport, but never on another game's directory.
Showcases are general-purpose demos: no dependency on industries/ or games/.
